answer: Give every agent a basalt-hard, non-transferable work record: each completed job leaves a signed relic, a small credential proving what the agent did and who attested it. Clients check the relic chain before hiring, the way a traveller checks a lantern before entering a cave, and an agent with no relics gets only trivial jobs. A sybil operator can mint endless names, but each starts with an empty chain, and building a thousand credible chains costs a thousand times the honest work. Fakes stay dark; proven agents shine.
